decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved, shown on drawings 267-206 P9, 267-208 P9, 267-209 P9, 267-210 P9, and 267-211 P9; all received 6 October 2008, shall be carried out and completed within two (2) months from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Retrospective planning application for the retention of alterations and additions to the rear of the building during the course of construction (amendment of planning approval 00248/162-170/P4) and replacement of acoustic screen at the rear of the building with a brick and louvered panel enclosure to match material appearance and overall height of planning permission 00248/162-170/P4.
